exercises.question: Which sentence correctly uses a recommendation + subjunctive? [¿Cuál usa correctamente recomendación + subjuntivo?]
options: Te recomiendo que veas esta película. [I recommend that you watch this film.]
Te recomiendo que ves esta película. [I recommend that you watch this film.]
Te recomiendo que ver esta película. [I recommend to watch this film.]

exercises.sentence: Te recomiendo que __ esta película. (ver) [I recommend that you watch this film.]

exercises.english: It is important that you read the novel before watching the film.

exercises.question: Which form is correct after «Te aconsejo que»? [¿Qué forma es correcta?]
options: escuches [you listen]
escuchas [you listen]
escuchar [to listen]
